verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents Datasets as reusable test-case sets and offline experiments run against them via UI, SDK (`run_experiment`) or CI/CD, with side-by-side comparison of runs. A hands-on community report confirms teams extract production generations into datasets to test edge cases, which covers the curation half of the story. missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly describing the trace-to-dataset curation workflow (e.g., adding traces or observations to a dataset from the UI or API), and independent corroboration of the offline experiment workflow.
